_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N342959 (2024-10-25, development Part 102 split; subject: "The tariff classification, country of origin marking, status under the United States-Mexico-Canada Trade Agreement (USMCA), and applicability of Section 301 Trade Remedies of a Server Rack"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held Germany. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8471.70.9000). Family: the family check (pcba_electronic_devices, 0.85); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (5: magazines, cartridges, robotic mechanism, cables, brackets). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target China by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for China are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
